Method of Attack: Locks users out of their PCs by requiring a password to access Windows
Blocks access to the computer with a password without encrypting the Windows SAM database
Runs even in Safe Mode making it difficult to disable without password or recovery tools
Attack Vector: Installation of Lock My PC software by tech support scammers
Indicators of Compromise: Password prompt dialog stating 'The computer has been locked'
Password prompt code '999901111' to get recovery code
